Scenario: Fresh clean builds and tampered lock/artifact
Acceptance: Reject altered or unpinned input; record lock, base digest, OS/native deps, final SBOM and build output.

Scenario: Nonroot UID/GID, missing/mispointed appdata, nested mount, readonly media
Acceptance: No root-required normal runtime; reject unsafe config roots; no media ownership rewrite; verify actual host permissions.

Scenario: Installer/uninstaller with appdata, occupied dir, junction, UNC, drive root and upgrades
Acceptance: No overwrite/delete unrelated data; per-user signed artifact; preserve appdata.

Scenario: Backup during active mutation, malformed or newer/older schema, failed validation
Acceptance: Quiesced or verified consistent snapshot with manifest; validate isolated copy before publication.

Scenario: Crash at each DB/WAL/config/key swap; partial restore/config write failure
Acceptance: Fenced journal, versioned rollback copies and verified recovery; never report ready until coherent set restored.

Scenario: Secrets/key mismatch, revoked token, retention and corrupted archive
Acceptance: Do not resurrect revoked credentials; encrypt/protect backups and restore copies, preserve current security policy; prove rollback.

Scenario: Embedded PostgreSQL major mismatch, full disk, process death, TERM
Acceptance: Fail safe before service startup; bounded shutdown and journal replay; separate external DB qualification.
Pinned versions/hash, extraction bounds, binary arch, exact license notices and SBOM; block unknown rights.

Scenario: Companion launcher/cache substitution, unsupported engine/JVM/extension, settings crash
Acceptance: Pinned companion and launcher digest, isolated permissions, revisioned config and compatible schema; no untrusted load.

Scenario: Mihon partial restore, category rename/missing mapping, cancellation, repeated restore
Acceptance: Preview mapping, preserve existing states, explicit per-entry receipts and errors; idempotent recovery; no deletion.
